verdict.rationale: Fathom is a meeting-recording SaaS that stores transcripts and recordings, so retention and erasure controls are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no retention policies, no scheduled auto-deletion, and no on-demand permanent erasure of transcripts or recordings. The only delete capability shown is removing a webhook, which is unrelated; admin view permissions and SSO/SCIM are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand
